follow-up time: Duration of pregnancy and postpartum period
finding: A high rate (43.3%) of MG worsening during pregnancy was observed, highlighting the need for multidisciplinary care, although no maternal or neonatal deaths occurred in the cohort.
mod_finding: The study found a high cesarean rate (64.3%) among pregnant women with myasthenia gravis but did not examine how mode of delivery related to other outcomes.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery: 38.2 weeks
